review.finding: blocked_by was a second hand-mirrored copy of the ready checks (_dep_blocker) that re-ran ancestry and its own git fetch; only the ready boolean went through ready_unit_ids, so reasons could disagree with the verdict (ready=false, blocked_by=[]).
review.disposition: accepted-and-fixed: single per-unit verdict unit_blockers(); ready == no blockers; blocked_by IS those blockers

review.finding: build_readiness could run K+1 git fetch origin per call (one per dependent of an off-base dependency).
review.disposition: accepted-and-fixed: per-call _Ancestry oracle memoizes per commit and fetches at most once; test pins fetch.call_count == 1

review.finding: Contract gate compares live shape to a fixture in the same tree (no origin/main git baseline); reason vocabulary not pinned.
review.disposition: partially-fixed: REASONS enum pinned in the fixture and asserted; fixture file name derived from READINESS_SCHEMA_VERSION. The contract_baseline git-baseline gate is NOT wired for this third producer (follow-up)

review.finding: Agreement test covered a single state; case-folded dependency and serial base not covered.
review.disposition: accepted-and-fixed: parametrized agreement test (case_mismatch, serial) + invariant pending-and-not-ready implies non-empty blocked_by

review.finding: cmd_readiness let KeyError/TypeError from a malformed state escape as a traceback.
review.disposition: accepted-and-fixed: structured {error: malformed_state} on stderr, exit 1, tested

notes: No behavior drift in next-batch; ADR-045 import identity clean; loop_claim.py shrinks 540 -> 519.
